## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (10/11) and cyclicals/financials showing strength (CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.43% | 1M: +28.19%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +5.88%)); Leadership concentration is Narrow (5/5 Technology in Top 5), so watch for concentrated tech-driven rotation.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology lead: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.44% | 1M: +55.21%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.75% | 1M: +30.31%). Industrials strong: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.43% | 1M: +28.19%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.49%). Consumer Staples showing strength via EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.51% | 1M: +25.30%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy lagging: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -9.29%), COP BELOW TREND (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -9.77%), OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -12.42%). Financials mixed with select weakness: MA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%), V CORRECTION (1W: -4.80% | 1M: +5.37%). Communication shows internal strain.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.44% | 1M: +55.21%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.47% | 1M: +32.46%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.27% | 1M: +113.59%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%). Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentration risk despite broad sector participation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -13.05% | 1M: -9.93%), OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -12.42%), COP BELOW TREND (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -9.77%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -11.97%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%). Weakness concentrated in Energy and select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +25.00%), QCOM (1W: +23.44%), INTC (1W: +19.27%), LRCX (1W: +19.47%), ORCL (1W: +18.43%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple mega-cap names (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION) show 1W vs 1M sign conflict — treat as tactical, not confirmation of durable leadership.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology mixed but leading on strength in semiconductors and software: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +13.42%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.75% | 1M: +30.31%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +16.69%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +11.19%), META CORRECTION (1W: -8.41% | 1M: +6.58%). Sector showing strong short-term leadership but with internal rotation and concentrated top performers.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials mixed but constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +5.88%), V CORRECTION (1W: -4.80% | 1M: +5.37%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%), PYPL CORRECTION (1W: -9.17% | 1M: +3.12%). Internal rotation across banks and payments — favor selective exposure to cyclical banks and underweight lagging payments names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare internally mixed: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.96% | 1M: +6.01%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -14.72%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -11.97%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +19.35%). Sector breadth and news-driven idiosyncrasies create stock-specific opportunities.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials/Industrials exposure and selected Technology leaders (AMD, QCOM, ORCL) while reducing exposure to weakest Energy names and deeply weak payments/fintech (SHOP, OXY, COP, MA). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt driven by semiconductors but remain selective due to narrow leadership and major divergence signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.43% | 1M: +28.19%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%).  
BEARISH: SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -13.05% | 1M: -9.93%), OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -12.42%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (leading semiconductors and software participation; narrow top performance). Industrials (CAT strength confirms cyclical flow).  
BEARISH: Energy (XOM, COP, OXY all BELOW TREND; sector return -3.29% 1W).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch sustainment of tech leadership vs pullbacks: NVDA CORRECTION hold above recent 1M trend to validate continuation; AAPL ABOVE TREND sustain above recent weekly lifts to confirm rotation; CAT ABOVE TREND break/hold above this week’s high to signal broader cyclical follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
AMD (+80): AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) — news (earnings/AI demand) confirms price strength and accumulation.  
(available bullish news coverage is concentrated but AMD is the clearest SP100 confirmation in price action).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
MA (-45): MA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) — regulatory probe headlines confirm recent price weakness.  
PYPL (-55): PYPL CORRECTION (1W: -9.17% | 1M: +3.12%) — negative headlines with short-term weakness but longer-term strength, divergence to monitor.  
RCL (-50): RCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.02% | 1M: +7.24%) — negative downgrade news diverging from strong price action, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Growth/Momentum tilt given tech semiconductors leading and cyclicals participating; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive.  
AMD, QCOM, INTC ABOVE TREND and CAT ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk: narrow tech leadership and MAJOR divergence among mega-caps (MSFT, NVDA, META showing weekly pullbacks) plus mixed sentiment (RCL/EL headlines diverging from price) — watch for trend confirmation.
